description: Finds the optimal value for a single parameter using golden-section search. Minimizes IAE (integral absolute error), overshoot, or settling_time within a [min, max] range. Converges in about 10 simulations.

blockId.description: ID of the block containing the parameter to tune

max.description: Upper bound of the search range

measureBlockId.description: Scope or Display block ID to read the controlled signal from

min.description: Lower bound of the search range

name: optimize_parameters
title: Optimize parameter
